title: "Finally, after 84 years..." - Arcane is back!

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 6 champion buffs, 8 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: "Finally, after 84 years..." - Arcane is back! Structured changes across 21 entities this patch.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.tldr: Recast time increased to 4 seconds from 3.5.; [Note: this does not affect any orders issued during the lockout.]
champions.gameplayImpact: Ambessa is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Various VO events no longer fail to trigger.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Homeguard trail VFX now displays correctly.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Dash pathfinding no longer ignores champion-generated terrain.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Using Supersonic during Drakehound's Step but after issuing a movement order no longer causes Ambessa's pathing speed to remain locked at the value of Supersonic's dash speed for the duration required to reach the movement order's destination, whatever distance that may have been (or otherwise until the order completes by any means, such as being canceled by the player, immobilizing crowd control, displacement, etc), thus illegally allowing her to move at an extraordinary speed.Youtube — Vandiril (14 November 2024) [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tCYBixnIJRM Rocketbelt Ambessa needs a fix...] [Note: Ambessa's actual movement speed statistic did not change during this interaction.]

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Dash can now properly be buffered and cast during travel.

lines.label: Recast time
lines.note: Recast time increased to 4 seconds from 3.5.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: If the cast is successful, all movement orders issued before seizing the target are now discarded upon the lockout ending (target being slammed onto the ground).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: [Note: this does not affect any orders issued during the lockout.]
